compiler.source: Official ETAS CLI 0.13.2 with its own Cargo.lock and exact Git dependencies; includes upstream single-pass string escape decoding (frontend #84/#85). No source overrides.

original_large_payload.manifest:
[package]
name="native-task-drain"
version="0.1.0"
edition="2026"
[source]
root="src"
[runtime]
default_profile="local"
[runtime.profiles.local.command]
allow=["/usr/bin/python3"]
isolation="trusted-unconfined"
[runtime.profiles.local.filesystem.regions."app.main.State"]
root="/probe-state"
read=false
write=true
[runtime.profiles.local.policy]
mode="local-static"
rules=["console=allow","command=allow","filesystem=allow"]
[[bin]]
name="native-task-drain"
module="app.main"
flow="main"

scope: Unchanged valid source literals and source-task/Host output interleaving with exact payload preservation. Production continuous draining and cancelled-read shutdown remain separate.
